title: Parent-teacher meeting
scenario: You are a parent meeting your child's teacher to discuss progress. The teacher has some concerns about your child's behavior.
greeting: Hello, thank you for coming in today. Please, have a seat.
objectives: Discuss what you can do at home

vocabulary.example: His behavior in class has been challenging.
How can we help her catch up?
How can I support him at home?

successCriteria: User listens and acknowledges the concerns
User proposes something to do at home
fallbackHints: Start with: 'Thank you for meeting with me. Tell me about [child]'s progress.'
Use: 'Could you give me an example?'
End with: 'Thank you for your time. I'll talk to him tonight.'
aiSystemPrompt: You are Ms. Thompson, a primary school teacher. The parent is here because you have concerns about their child's behavior or progress. Be warm but honest. Use specific examples. Avoid jargon. Show that you care about the child and want to work together with the parent. Correct major mistakes gently.
firstTurn: Hello, thank you for coming in. I wanted to talk to you about your child's progress this term.
